review_description: Can’t fault the whole process from the first phone call to the install was simple. All our questions were answered and in the end we opted for a larger battery and so glad we did. The installation process was excellent the crew were very tidy and thorough. They ensured everything was working and all rubbish was removed before they left.
Very good package. Informative, good service and great price. Install very well done and no hassle.

Sales quoting process was very thorough and Informative.  The inatallation team waa punctual, Informative, polite and tidied up after installation was complete.The installers then helped us to  with the app after the battery was connected and explained the application of this.

Class A Energy Solutions did a great job from sales through to installation on our new home.Our system is 24kw of Solar mounted on north and west facing roof faces.To keep us power neutral we coupled them to a 20kw Sigenergy inverter on top 32kw battery.We love the wifi app its very intuative and allows us to be informed so we can manage high current loads.Sigenergy Gateway handles the cutover in the event of grid power failure.We are very happy.Regards Richard & Gail.

Sales person was excellent and knowledgeable.  A site visit was arranged and he confirmed that it all looked feasible.  They were not the lowest quote but we accepted their quote at the end of August based on the service in the quoting process.After paying a deposit there has been very poor level of communication with the firm and they have not even scheduled an installation date even though I was told that the have the battery in stock
The sales process was quick and negotiable. The installations was amazing, very polite guys , clean and tidy. They showed me how to use the app but was told I have no need for any other info.

Excellent Tesla battery system at a great price. Installation started well, but a difficult one due to limestone walling (not flat). Installers excellent but unable to complete it due to Tesla battery installation problems not being able to attach  battery directly onto wall. They are coming back to complete installation another day. Soon I hope. Installers punctual.efficient and tidy completing partial installation and cabling. Waiting for communication from Class A Energy Solutions in Adelaide for completion of install.( Battery installed to existing 6kw solar system with Fronius inverter.)
A most professional company to deal with from start to finish. Very happy to recommend them.

The sales process was easy. Shane came to our home and talked us through the entire process and quote. Although the installation was delayed at the end we were really impressed with John, our installer. He shared his knowledge which gave us confidence in our decision. John was knowledge, friendly and helpful. He explained the entire process to us from the beginning to installing the app. on our phone.

The installation was fantastic and the installer was even better. He answered all our questions and even researched the more difficult ones. He took the time to explain things in layman terms. We really appreciated this.
Absolutely outstanding solar installation! The team was professional, efficient, and left everything perfectly set up – highly recommended!
Sales and quoting process went smoothly. Installers were polite and on time.

Had to chase this company up a few times to find out install date. Calls not returned as promised. Installer had to come out 3 times to complete job. Battery didn't work after initial install. Had to chase up again with phone calls and email. Battery finally working now. Customer service needs much improvement
Install was neat and tidy, showed me what needs to be done in case of emergency or basically said if you need anything gives us a call .

The system was installed very efficiently. A few days after there was a blackout and our system did not behave as expected. We were quoted an extra $1600 for installation of battery backup. After lodging a complaint wit the SA Consumer Affairs Class A said they would investigate. We heard nothing for a while as we were travelling but on return inquired of Class A what was happening. We were told they had attended and fixed the proble. Apparently a faulty Current Transformer. All appears to be OK now.

Prompt quote, very happy to answer any questions, fast installation - only 2 weeks from receipt of quote.  The work team that installed the system were outstanding - a well organised group of workers that worked together like a dream, I cannot speak highly enough of the professionalism and quality of work on the day of installation.

The sales people seemed o know their products and explained everything well and quotes were prompt and easy to understand how the installation would go. I chose the person who gave me the more technical answers to pros and cons of different system set ups. The installation was great and well explained. Any issues that arose were talked through and everything was completed on time.

The sales process was made easy with the insights of Solarquotes. Our 3 quotes were all in the same ball park so then our decision came down to who would be the most accommodating.All the staff and crew were very polite and respectful, they all took the time to answer our questions when asked.The crew went the extra mile to preserve the integrity of our roof, 36 year old cement roof tiles which are quite fragile. They took the time to replace all broken tiles with our spares that we had available.They removed our old system and replaced with a larger system and took all rubbish and components away.The system was installed in 1-1/2 days and has been running since. We haven't contacted our energy supplier yet, waiting for our next bill, we have had issues with their metre reader and will be negotiating for a smart meter if possible.All in all a very pleasant experience.

Very happy all round.Initial contact was prompt and all requested details provided.Installation was hampered by weather issues but still completed in the requested timeframe.Post installtion requirements also well managed.Highly recommended.
Excellent installer, a difficult install completed with care and communication and no additional cost even though it took 3.5 days rather than 2.
Good sales, good after sales support. Punctual installers, communicative and fuss free.

Excellent assistance from salesperson with prompt replies to my queries. Best price and relatively quick installation. Installer came on nominated day and checked the following day as to whether all good. Very satisfied with the whole process.

Wow what a fantastic experience I have had in deciding to purchase a solar system. From the initial approach to Class A Energy Solutions to the final installation, I cannot believe how easy this has been. Can highly recommend Class A Energy Solutions, the level of customer service was exceptional. From Shane who took time to explain the process and answered my questions during quoting and sales to Tom the installer. Connection to the grid was organised, helped me set up the app on my phone, and followed up to check if my energy retailer had done their thing. Thanks for taking the stress out of jumping on the solar bandwagon.

Bad experience with TINDO. Would like to make potential client carful with paying deposits as if you later find a beter company they will not return your money, regardless of what the deposit was. Cheers. Louka

Quoting system was honest and efficient. I did go to their location when I chose them to pay a cash deposit. They were very patient with me and explained and showed me the bracket system they use.  The installers were punctual, tidy and respectful to all.eg no shouting or swearing .They were honest and told me they cracked a tile and found 2 other ones that were damaged and installed them all. Of course that made me feel happy. They finish at the time they said, also patiently explaining the inverter ect. With out hesitation they rest my auto pool clock for better efficiently as I had trouble seeing the clock numbers .They set the grid connection and they system starting working right away. Over all they were a great team and I believe they should succeed for a long time.

From the quote to installation it was a smooth process. Installed 2 weeks after quoting, faster than expected. All other companies had a waiting time of up to 4 months.The system and battery were installed in 1 day, even during showers.Everyone from sales person to installers was friendly and professional.Couldn't be happier with my choice.

Class A Energy Solutions are great to deal with in every part of getting a solar system. Shane in sales made it so easy and had no problem answering any questions I put to him. He also was patient and discussed the right system for my needs with suggestions and explanations rather than just pushing me to buy a certain system. The install went smoothly and I was generating solar power quicker than I thought I would be. Very happy over all aspects of dealing with Class A Energy Solutions.

The system was well explained prior to purchase and the communication was outstanding before during and after installation.There were a few problems with our roof but this was quickly overcome and explained at no extra cost.

I was impressed with the sales person, who promoted a system for me that was of high quality and yet cheaper than what I had expected to pay.  Eg, a Goodwe inverter rather than the more expensive Solar Edge or Fronius.  He was really helpful with all aspects of the process including facilitating the Smart meter install happening.  Also, Class A Energy Solutions have experience with installing EV vehicle chargers and I was comfortable with his understanding of where I need it to be placed to be most useful for me.  I was really happy with the company, with the prompt installation of the solar system, and I'm expecting Class A Energy Solutions to put the EV charger where I want it in due course.

The installation was conducted professionally and appears to be functioning well. The personnel were friendly and informative. Shane , in particular was particularly easy to deal with.Re value for money and quality of the system, it is rather premature to judge as I have no technical expertise.

After extensive research we settled on Class A Energy Solutions (suggested by SolarQuotes) for our 7.8kWh system with a GoodWe GW6000-MS Inverter.  Marlon made the process so easy with his outstanding communication and explanation of how everything works and what we needed.  I informed Marlon we were ready to install our system (thinking I would have to wait a few weeks) and to my surprise it was installed the following day!  Andrew and Bruce were very prompt, arriving when promised and very friendly.  After a morning chat they got to work and kept me updated throughout the day.  Our configuration needed to be changed after Andrew did exact measurements of our roof space and drew a plan to show me the new placement.  He showed me how and why and explained everything.  His solution was brilliant and our system was up and running that afternoon.  Bruce connected our inverter to Wifi and helped me with the App.  Class A are brilliant to deal with and I was so happy I chose a local business (we are in Littlehampton, SA) over a national provider.  The service is personal, caring and professional - they really cared about what we wanted and what would work best for us. The whole process has been outstanding, and I HIGHLY recommend this company.

Sales process was straight forward. Install went well with good team and was able to happen quickly due to been a smaller system, which they could fit in between larger installsCompany organised grid connection.Only issue was they failed to wire the hot water system through the additional system Meter. Company still has not responded about fixing. Apart from that happy with service.

Guys and girls installing the system were great, easy to deal with. We are just waiting for final grid connection and last bit of instal as we got Covid at the beginning of January which has held things up

During my solar quotes process I had multiple quotes from different providers, Class A was by far the best experience I had from sales to installation. There was no pushy sales talk, no pressure! I ended up having multiple lengthy conversations with Shane and felt confident with him and Class A. Installation was quick, and professional! Will recommend them to anyone looking for solar.
Very professional. Polite. Tidy. Kept us informed.Hard workers. Thanks

I found Class A Energy Solutions to be friendly and helpful when I was enquiring about putting solar on and prompting sent me a competitive quote. Upon accepting the quote they were able to instal the system a lot quicker than I expected. The installation was completed quickly by polite tradesmen. Overal I was extremely happy with the experience.
Quick and simple, what else do you expect when one word says it ?
Completely satisfied with service and result. Absolutely no hesitation in recommending.

Firstly, ALL companies I deal with were very helpful and professional.The company I chose was;- fantastic with the quoting process and all questions were answered promptly.- installation was carried out by friendly and happy tradesmen. The job was started when quoted and was completed very professionally. Additionally, my roof was repaired when required and the job was left clean and tidy.- customer service was extremely good. Everything through to organisation of connection was taken care of for me. I didn't have to do a thing in this area.

Very happy with Shane, Ash and John who guided me through the process of Solar and Battery system selection and instal. A few minor hiccups along the way have been quickly dealt with. Very happy with the outcome. Would recommend.

They were very open during the quoting process and afterwards given price variations.The installers were terrific, friendly and quick - very professionalDid all the work behind the defences with my retailer etc.Very happy with the process and outcome.
Jason Giggle was wonderful to deal with .Miles Ratliff was very nice & understanding.
The sales process was very honest, consistent and transparent.The installation was punctual and carefree.The customer service has been really good since the first phone call.

We decided on the Powerwall-2 - it's a no-brainer really (see SolarQuotes for why!) - despite its expense - and we paid the deposit at the end of September 2021 and signed up for the $2000 rebate from the SA Govt. In January 2022 I queried the progress and was told it'd be installed before the rebate expired in April. In March I received an invoice, but no installation had taken place. I queried this and was informed the installation would be soon. It was eventually installed in mid-May and I had to reapply for the rebate. It seems the accounts side was struggling to cope with the rush of installations, and there may also have been issues with getting batteries to Australia. The people themselves at Class-A were however always polite and helpful.As an aside, it seems Tesla is very pernickety about the installation (not on this wall, 600mm away from other stuff, etc.) which adds to the negotiation that the installer has to engage in.Anyway, the upside is that I locked in the price before two price increases by Tesla, so I'm very happy with that! And the app is an absolute treat - very glad I went with the Powerwall.
Great to do business with assisted and kept informed during the whole process. Would recommend.

Having had our Tesla and solar in for over two Months now we are very happy. We do not get a power bill and have used the back up twice when the power from the grid went down.Class A were a delight to deal with. Shane explained everything and the install was faultless.What a breath of fresh air dealing with a company that actually cares. Highly recommend this company.

We had our 13kw solar system along with our battery installed with Class A. We were not surprised with the professional service as we were recommended to only use Class A from a friend.With so much noise in this industry we just wanted a quality system from a company that has been around for a long time and this company is a stand out. Don’t get burnt just call Class A.Highly recommend....

Great service from start to finish. Shane overloaded us with information to be sure we got the best system that suited our needs.The office team were fantastic and the install was faultless.We went with Class A because of how long they have been in business as well as the positive reviews we have read.Highly recommend this company if you are looking for a solar system.

Class A delivered in spades. The sales process was very informative and Shane explained every part of the install which went exactly to plan.The system has delivered more savings than I expected and my last bill was $14.Highly recommend Class A they deliver what they promise. The install team were amazing well presented on time and cleaned up their mess. I even got a follow up call after a Month to make sure I was happy.

Class A Energy Solutions was one of a number of quotes I obtained. They were the only installer that could install my system within a couple of weeks. The others were 6 to 8 weeks hence. The quoting process was straight forward as by then I had accumulated a significant amount of knowledge (from the other suppliers and the Solar Quotes website). Installation was quickly arranged and scheduled however there was a glitch on the day with light rain falling. The installers advised me I would have to reschedule, packed up and left. Of course, it stopped raining as soon as they disappeared. No matter, the rescheduled installation took place a few days later. The installers were very professional and completed the work with the minimum of fuss. Greg did a great job with the inverter and the panel and stepped me through the operation and the software. The site was left clean and tidy. Class A also arranged for AGL to install the smart meter which was completed a few days later. Although it is a little early to tell but indications are that the system is operating to expectations. Thanks to Solar Quotes for the introduction plus all the valuable information on their website and on YouTube. Cheers, Anthony B.

Sales person easy and courteous to deal with giving precise details of recommended system with no pushy sales pitch.Installation team of three persons were on time, very tidy and professional in the work being carried outThe associated documentation for grid connect process was handled within one day of finishing the installation.Based on my experience I can totally recommend Class A Energy Solutions in Adelaide

Process was very easy, Shane was very accomodating, easy to talk to and answered all my questions (and they were plenty). From quoting, to explaining how everything would work, to delivery and installation, I was happy with it all once we decided to go ahead. In less than a week from acceptance of the quote, we had our system installed. I have since recommended them to another friend who are having their panels installed with them too.

The sales/quoting process went well - I asked the seller to come and inspect my home to discuss any issues, and he did.Unfortunately, on the day of installation, the electrician decided to install the inverter in a different position from the one previously discussed, justifying the choice based on the difficulty of performing a different electrical wiring. The current location of the inverter is not ideal, as it is exposed to the sun all afternoon.I am currently considering the possibility of protecting the inverter with a shield.Also the involvement of Intellihub Metering, to be the Relevant Agent able to remotely disconnect and reconnect the solar generation plant from the distribution network, looked strange and/or unjustified, as I don't think that any dedicated relays has been installed.Customer service helped with connecting to the network; however, I had to contact the energy provider to ask for meter reconfiguration (which I was told was unnecessary)

I raised three quotes and Class A Energy was the first to return my enquiry.I got the best price, top the line system and great service, I reached out to them a few times to clear some questions and they were very attentive and provided all the information I needed.

From first contact with Class A, through to the installation and getting me logged into the monitoring, was a smooth and seamless process. Due to my roof style I was told up front there would be some additional cost which was very professional of them - no extra hidden fees.They were also the only one of 3 companies I contacted that highlighted my odd 2 phase setup, and explained about the use of crawl boards for installation.Highly recommended.

Shane sorted a quote, paperwork to install without any hassle and did so impressively quickly too. Was quoted a real world price (not a suss internet special price) on a great system at a very competitve price. After doing some research on the proposed system and comparing against competing quotes, it was clear that Shane had taken the time to understand my requirements and had designed a system that was perfect for my families needs. Flawless install over 1.5 days on a tricky roof, our house was left spotlessly clean. Would definitely recommend Shane and Class A Energy Solutions.

You know when you have to organise something as unsexy as solar power and you dread the phone calls with sales people who are going to throw information at you with very little concern that you, if you’re like me, have no bloody idea what they’re talking about because all you want is a quality product at a fair price installed by tradies who are going to treat your dog with love.Well, all I can say is thank god for Class A Energy Solutions. As soon soon as Shane called me, and I’m not going to lie, he did talk about things like kilowatts and inverters and shading and roof tilting, and I did start dreaming of the new shoes I was thinking about buying when I no longer had power bills.He assured me of the quality panels and inverters they used, rebuffed me about wasting my money when I tried to upsell things to myself (because I am nothing if not ignorant about what I think I need) and guaranteed that the workmanship is covered for 12 years. After getting the quote to me within a day, I read it and because of my said lapse in concentration, he patiently and very promptly answered all of my many emails with details he’d previously gone through.I was given an installation date and time, the tradies turned up exactly when they said they would with a courtesy call on the day to say they were on their way, and they managed to both seamlessly install my solar while giving my dog Curly - a kelpie who saw his job as supervising the roof works - the hugs and respect he thinks he deserves.The whole process from phone call to installation took less time than it takes me to decide what tv programs I’ll be watching next month. If you have read this far - and props to you if you have - I cannot recommend this company and my experience with them enough. Thanks to everyone involved in my effort to one day live off grid and start wearing vegan sandals (obvs this last bit is a joke. I don’t wear sandals.).
A very neat installation job. Now just waiting for new meter so I can start using it.

Very happy with the experience with Class A Energy Solutions. The guys who did the install were on time and did a professional job.The connection process was easy and faultless. System is up and running and making me money already.
Sales person was very helpful and the installation was easy with the guys arriving on time.  The service has been wonderful, everything has been organised for me

Wonderful service with happy, polite installers. The company kept in touch prior to installation as I also needed a metre board upgrade and something on the power pole also needed an upgrade. Connection to the grid was done after the installation. All in all I'm very happy.The reason I gave 4 stars for installation was because some clamps weren't tightened and 3 panels came off. This was quickly rectified and panels were replaced.

Quoting process was simple and very informative, with easy to understand options.Installation they were punctual and tidy and rang me with a couple of issues which were quickly resolved.So far customer service ok. They did help with grid connection
Good work from the sales person right down to the installers and then the setting up of the system on the phone. No complaints

It's been a long time since i could say honestly a company did everything right. From the initial sales contact through the quote, pre inspection, installation and after sales service Class A have got it right. Their teams are in tune with each other and were with me. Cannot praise them high enough. Thoroughly recommend them although i had never heard of them prior to Solarquotes contact.

Found the quoting to be up front with no pressure which I had from another company during getting quotes. Installation was fast the guys were punctual , polite and professional and did clean up after themselves. Grid connection was all done and running fine. there is a problem with the information I get from my phone App now and intelli hub might be the cause. SA power are coming out Monday to check where the problem is .
inverter and battery have not yet been installed, this is still being arranged. Miles has been very helpful

Installers were fantastic they had to change the panel placement told us why,Which made total sense. They were very punctual & tidy. Finished in the time frame given, explained everything.Totally happy

From quote acceptance to install, Class A was exceptional.Installation was quick, tradesmen tidy and professional and we were kept informed throughout the process.We're very happy with our additional panels and Tesla battery - thank you.
Sales staff were informative and not too pushy.  Installation guys were really focussed on getting it right and did a great job.
They made it so easy.Was installed in less than 2 weeksQuote was very reasonable and even less for cash price.Everything was very straight forward.

Have only ordered the system so can only talk about the process.George from Class A Energy Solutions was excellent, he was patient, understanding and had good product knowledge.Though I selected a "Kia", am looking forward to installation.If it wasn't for Finn and the team, I would not have even started the process.

I am very happy at the moment with our solar system.  We certainly wouldn’t have felt as confident as we did without solarquotes.com.au Class A Electrical from the sales person to the installers were great.  Communication was excellent and can’t be faulted.
My roof has many faces makes it very difficult to install. The engineers did a great job by getting them all up on the roof.Well done team, highly recommended.
Very professional sales person, helped all the way through process. Installers did a great job, admin provided no fuss easy delivery of service including arranging everything.

Great Service. Productive, Informative, Patient, and Tenacious when required,Highly Recommended!We would like to take this opportunity to thank Miles Ratcliff an his Professional Team at  Class A Energy Solutions.for the installation they have done at our home.It has not been easy!We live in a Retirement Village, and the placement of Solar panels, Battery and control panels had to satisfy the strict requirements dictated by the Village Manager.The Battery had to be changed under warranty.It took some time of negotiations with Village Management, but in the end all parties were happy.MilesRatcliff,  and team thank you for your Tenacity, Patience and Flexibility!Peter and Sharon Kuller

Customer service was great and gave me the best price for better quality equipment. The installers were also reasonable and patient with my timing. Due to poor weather they did rock up over the weekend to get the job finished luckily it was not an inconvenience since it was such short notice.

Installation was quick, and punctual.  Did the complete install in one go.Sales process was good, polite, not pushy at all.Price was good, bet of the 3 quotes I got, for comparable equipmentI recommend this company as a solar system retailer and installer

Great salesman, Shane Nielsen, who answered hundreds of emails and questions very quickly. Great install team led by Tim, who were polite efficient and easy to talk to. Great follow up service form the admin team, led by Cassia.
All very good across the board from start to finish

The salesperson was charismatic and knowledgeable, he was very helpful in recommending a system and explaining it thoroughly, and was most willing to answer my several rounds of followup questions extremely promptly. They were willing to match the installation warranty and price of another very similar quote when I was stuck trying to decide between two great sounding companies.We almost got lucky with an early installation, but that had to be cancelled due to insane hot weather putting them behind schedule. Installation proceeded smoothly on the second date that we set (which was around the date that they originally indicated during quotation). The installers were friendly, tidy and efficient. The panels and inverter look neat and appear to be functioning beautifully - we already had the right kind of power box so our new power got to start up on the spot. Class A organised all of the grid connection paperwork stuff and didn't need any input on it from me apart from a signature, very convenient.My only slight negative is that they did say they would do a site visit prior to installation, to find the best spots for the panels and inverter. Somehow that never ended up happening, probably because Christmas, new year and holidays were all happening around then. I forgot about it in all the December madness and they never contacted me to arrange it, perhaps for a similar reason. I suspect if that visit had happened the panels would have ended up shifted over slightly, reducing the impact of morning shade on one edge, but I could be wrong.

I would like to take this opportunity and thank Mr Miles Ratcliff and his professional team at Class A Energy Solutions for such a fantastic job that they have done for my beautiful house. He gave me a few competitive quotes with some logical advices and installation plan. Then they design, install, implement and run the solar system with high quality and respectful technicians.Finally we agreed easily on a reasonable payment plan to fix the contract.Thank you every one at "Class A Energy Solutions"

Sales and quoting was easy and quick, all they needed was the address and recent power bills.Quote came back quickly, communication was really good, factual, very knowledgeable, no BS or hard sell slimy sales techniques at all.Installation was arranged much sooner than we'd expected, the installers arrived early on the day of installation...!Both installers were really pleasant to deal with and they completed the job over two days, Friday and Monday. They removed ALL the waste material and left the site very clean and tidy (Big plus)Some very minor repairs were required to roof joists in the house, installers couldn't see the joists from outside on our old house.The customer service we received throughout has been absolutely superb, the repair issue were resolved extremely quickly with excellent communication and collaboration from Miles.Grid connection and dealing with the energy provider was a very easy process.Overall, we can very highly recommend these guys, there's a really good reason they've been in business for so long.They know what they're doing, provide great advice and excellent service with no BS.
Sales team were excellent and knowledgeable installation team will quick efficientOverall better experience than I thought very happy with my system

A quick, energetic response for a quote. Installation was well done by hard working crew. The crew installed my Tesla app At the end of the job.I do have one concern. This firm, like all other suppliers, are really just well briefed salesmen. I still have no real understanding of the way the Tesla Works or how to get the best out of it. In my case this is important because the initial aim was to replace a diesel generator for mains failure. So they set the app to hold a constant 70% as back up. The remaining panel source- 6 x 175 w -used simply to support mains supply. I need to be able to use more panel power at times when mains failure is remote. The mains failure is meant mainly to run two flood pumps.

We found Class A Energy Solutions via the SolarQuotes website, having had little success with calling companies direct.We dealt with Shane who was amazing.  He answered all of our questions, gave us the pro's and con's of the different inverters and panels, and was straight to the point.  He did what all other companies failed to do... he under promised and over delivered!  Shane and the owner Miles also came out to our property to work out what was best for our new house  in the Adelaide Hills and how many panels we could fit on the roof.  Shane even went above and beyond and helped us with getting the NMI set up, he was brilliant.  The whole process was smooth and we now have our 8.8kw panels installed - even the install guys were lovely, and there was no mess!!We would without doubt recommend Class A Energy Solutions for all of your solar needs.

Class A were not the cheapest (but still very competitive). Yet for this I got an install that was tailor designed for my home and (most importantly) actual energy use, high quality name-brand components, workmanship clearly geared up and experienced with big commercial installs, service that was nothing short of outstanding, the install (and even showing up) happened earlier than expected, every single piece of rubbish, off-cut, and dust taken with them, and thereafter followed up to ensure I was happy.As we all know the solar industry is overwhelmed with companies that install systems for a few years, build a mass of complaints about their workmanship and underperforming/failing systems, and then vanish.  Salesmen in general give you a copy & paste quote and are pushy.  Tradesmen in general, even the best of them, don't show up when they say and leave you with a clean-up and rubbish to dispose of.  Prices are becoming insanely attractive but use cheap components and shortcuts taken during install.My experience with solar started this way.  Company after company sending me a generic quote or making appointments to come see me but never showing up.  Those who came and saw, or I pre-warned in advance, my house having a roof like a "church" (our upper floor is contained within the roof making it very steep and very tall) all RAN and were never heard from again.Then came Class A.  Shane insisted on learning what our goals were, he studied our electricity bills to understand our actual energy use throughout the seasons of the year, and even used satellite images to scale an initial plan of what we could fit.  He came to site (in his own time I might add as I was working long hours that week due to COVID-19) and was not at all concerned about our "church" roof - these guys do commercial installs so climbing structures is second nature to them.  During this time I still had more calls, emails, and visits from other vendors - the difference between them and Shane's passion and legitimate interest in delivering us a quality system specifically designed to suit our needs (including factoring many personal requests) made the decision very easy.Next I received a call from David to co-ordinate the install - two weeks earlier than expected, which was a wonderful surprise.  David also took the time to make sure we were still on the same page and whether I had any concerns or questions.Michael and his team then showed up - not late as you typically expect of tradesmen but EARLY.  They ran through the work with me and, once again, took the time to make sure we were still in agreement and whether I had any questions.  They then got stuck into not installing, but getting up on the roof and planning out the logistics of the work.  Next one of them did the inverter while the other began installing all the mountings and wiring - the way in which they achieved this on our "church" roof proving why Class A were the right choice for the job.Our install was massive - a huge and difficult roof, three surfaces, and 38 panels - so they did fall behind.  However, they didn't break this news to me at the end of the day - they proactively spoke with me at midday to advise they could foresee extra time being needed the following day.  Neither my wife or I could be there for that but you know what - these guys were a first-class act so I had no hesitation in giving them unattended access.  Once again they were EARLY which meant no stress waiting to head off to work.At the end of both days they took all their rubbish with them - right down to every single off-cut of wire.  I could not find a thing to pick up or clean after them - and yet my bins were empty.  Who does this?!?To top this off I then get a phone call from Miles to step through setting up the remote monitoring - and the one and only issue I raise he and Shane then went above and beyond in sorting out for me.I probably sound like an inside review but honestly my experience with Class A, from the very first call right through to completion (and thereafter), was nothing short of outstanding. If you are intending to go solar, please read this, it may be of assistance.Our initial search on the web about solar power resulted in an extraordinarily steep learning curve.  After some months of looking at various companies and systems we resorted to a web guy named Finn Peacock, the founder of Solar Quotes. Finn recommended three solar companies for quotes.  We chose Class A Energy Solutions for various reasons, one being that the salesperson, Shane Nielsen had a superb knowledge on the subject and always answered his phone or returned calls very promptly. After some humming and harring (and many questions) we finally selected a system.At the pre-arranged time an electrician and an apprentice from NBF Electrical arrived at our reasonably remote property on Yorke Peninsula, South Australia. The solar panels were to be fitted on a tin shed roof and wired to the house through existing underground conduit.  The conduit was not good enough for the job and new cables needed to be installed underground. This meant an approximately 35 metre trench had to be dug.  Much to the credit of Class A Energy Solutions they arranged a digging machine and operator and fit the new and appropriate conduit and cables at no cost to us.   A week or so later the machine, an operator, two electricians, an apprentice and a work experience guy arrived then set about installing the solar panels and battery system. It was quite a large job which continued on into the next day with two of the electricians seeking shelter that night in a caravan park nearby.The following day the system was switched on and it worked splendidly except our Wi Fi device was incapable of connecting to the inverter.  We were unable to read what was going on as far as how much electricity was being produced and how the system was performing.  The NBF electricians said they would be back at a later date with a Wi Fi extender to boost the signal.  We signed off on the contract and paid the money and true to their word NBF Electrical returned and finished the job.The nuts and bolts of this case are:Finn Peacock, of Solar Quotes; excellent.Shane Nielsen, salesperson, from Class A Energy Solutions, excellent.Miles Ratcliff owner of Class A Energy Solutions also excellent in covering the cost of the trench digging and Wi Fi extender.NBF Electrical was efficient, friendly and brilliant with the installation of panels and batteries.  When Nathan Fielke, the boss of NBF Electrical returned with the Wi Fi extender he spent nearly a whole day making sure everything was working correctly and explaining in great detail how the whole system worked.  To say the least, we were both tremendously impressed.  Class A Energy Solutions have a superb team.If we were not so remote the initial glitch about the conduit and then needing a trench probably would not have occurred. That along with the Wi Fi not connecting to the inverter was very minor in the overall installation.  We believe that they have learned from this hiccup with remote properties or with other things that might be problematical, and will have an electrician/salesperson attend to assess those situations before contracts are signed.Would we go down the same path with the same companies and people?  Yes, you betcha, without a doubt.  We both feel that we have made all the right moves by exhaustive investigating coupled with a smidgeon of luck, and we have ended up with a really great solar system. We can only conclude that we wholly recommend our particular path to solar and the people and companies involved in making it so.  Bring on the sun. ?David & Lee
